concerns.text: Edge case 'retrieval step returns zero relevant command sequences' (system must proceed with standard prompting, logging the miss) has no backing FR. FR-004 covers retrieval but not the zero-hit fallback/logging behavior. Add an FR (anchored to US-2) or extend FR-004.

Edge case '6-hour timeout reached during batch execution' (graceful termination, record partial results, flag timeout) is only partially covered: FR-002 sets the timeout but no FR specifies graceful termination/partial-result recording/timeout flagging. Add or extend an FR anchored to US-1.
